description: This file manages a cache for Discord user directory lookups, including normalization of account IDs, handles, and Snowflake IDs, as well as cache management functions for storing and resolving user IDs based on handles.

methods.name: normalizeAccountCacheKey
methods.description: Normalizes the account ID to be used as a cache key, defaulting to DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID if input is null or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeSnowflake
methods.description: Converts a string, number, or bigint into a normalized Snowflake ID string or null if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeHandleKey
methods.description: Trims and lowercases a Discord handle, removing '@' prefix and validating format.

methods.name: ensureAccountCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cache Map for a given account ID.

methods.name: setCacheEntry
methods.description: Sets a user ID in the cache for a given handle, maintaining cache size limit.
